verdict.rationale: LocalAI does not document SDKs of its own. Its documented approach is to expose OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages APIs, so developers can call the runtime from existing OpenAI or Claude client libraries by pointing them at the local server. Its Swagger spec could also be used to generate clients, but that is only a building block. missing for 10: first-party LocalAI-maintained Python/JavaScript client libraries, language-specific SDK docs or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript

citations.quote: You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
LocalAI supports the Anthropic Messages API, which is compatible with Claude clients.
